jsonLd.subCategory: Food truck and catering ordering system
jsonLd.description: Ordering, pre-orders and a kitchen screen for {country} food trucks and catering.

shots.dashboardAlt: Taking an order on HatchGrab: the menu on the left, the running cart and total on the right
shots.phoneAlt: Ordering from a food truck on HatchGrab: the menu with photos and prices, and a running cart total

does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, reliable wifi and the same hours every week. You’re somewhere new every week, at different times, with spotty or no cell service. HatchGrab was built for that.
does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose a pickup time. Shorter lines, and food ready when they arrive.
does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at once, and how long it takes. Once a pickup time is full, customers can’t pick it.
does.devicesBody: Runs on the phone in your apron, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the truck — and the card reader you already take payment on.
does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Your WhatsApp gets answered while you’re driving to your spot or at the grill, using your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon.
does.whatsappSoonBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Soon your WhatsApp will get answered while you’re driving to your spot or at the grill. Messenger and Instagram to follow.
does.offlineBody: If you lose signal, online ordering pauses automatically so customers can’t place orders you won’t see. Continue taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.

steps.lede: Three things to set up — and two of them just need a photo.
steps.menuBody: Photograph your board or paste it in. Items, prices and extras all come through on their own. You just check they’re right.
steps.shareBody: Post it on Facebook, stick the QR on the truck. Orders land on your screen, in the order you need to cook them.

final.lede: Upload a photo or screenshot of your menu and we’ll turn it into a working ordering page for you to try out in under 60 seconds. Your items, your prices. No sign-up, no card, nothing to install. Take a look, then decide.
